question: 売上の最初の見積もりと確定値は、どれくらい違った？

attempts.llm:
```sql
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        revenue_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY revenue_month ORDER BY snapshot_date) AS rn,
        is_finalized
    FROM main_mart.fct_revenue
),
first AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        SUM(revenue_amount) AS first_estimate
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1               -- 最初のスナップショット（見積もり）
    GROUP BY revenue_month
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        SUM(revenue_amount) AS finalized
    FROM ranked
    WHERE is_finalized          -- 確定したスナップショット
    GROUP BY revenue_month
)
SELECT
    revenue_month,
    first_estimate,
    finalized,
    (finalized - first_estimate)                     AS diff,
    CASE
        WHEN first_estimate = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (finalized - first_estimate) * 100.0 / first_estimate
    END                                             AS pct_diff
FROM (
    -- 月別
    SELECT f.revenue_month, f.first_estimate, fin.finalized
    FROM first f
    JOIN final fin USING (revenue_month)

    UNION ALL

    -- 全体合計
    SELECT
        'TOTAL' AS revenue_month,
        SUM(f.first_estimate) AS first_estimate,
        SUM(fin.finalized)    AS finalized
    FROM first f
    JOIN final fin USING (revenue_month)
) t
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN revenue_month = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    revenue_month;
```
